title: Neural-Surrogate Co-Design of Aerodynamic Shape and Control
abstract: arXiv:2603.06760v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Control co-design jointly optimizes a robot's physical design and its controller. Existing techniques are limited in the number of model parameters and the complexity of the physical models they can handle. In this paper, we propose a gradient-based bilevel formulation that replaces the dynamics models of earlier techniques with a differentiable neural surrogate and differentiates through the trajectory optimizer using a structure-exploiting approach. We validate the framework on fixed-wing gliders, using NeuralFoil as the aerodynamic surrogate. The tasks are maximum-distance gliding, minimum-distance landing, and perching. Experiments on 2D airfoils and 3D wings show that our method runs about five times faster than a state-of-the-art evolutionary baseline. It also outperforms pipelines that optimize aerodynamic proxy metrics.

translated_title: 基于神经代理模型的气动外形与控制协同设计
translated_abstract: 控制协同设计（Control co-design）对机器人的物理设计及其控制器进行联合优化。现有技术在可处理的模型参数数量和物理模型复杂度方面存在局限。本文提出了一种基于梯度的双层（bilevel）优化公式，用可微分的神经代理模型取代以往技术中的动力学模型，并采用一种利用问题结构的方法对轨迹优化器进行微分。我们在固定翼滑翔机上验证了该框架，使用 NeuralFoil 作为气动代理模型。所研究的任务包括最大距离滑翔、最小距离着陆和栖停（perching）。在二维翼型和三维机翼上的实验表明，我们的方法比最先进的进化算法基线快约五倍，并且优于那些优化气动代理指标的流程。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于梯度的双层协同设计框架，用可微分神经代理模型（NeuralFoil）替代动力学模型，在固定翼滑翔机的滑翔、着陆和栖停任务上比最先进的进化算法快约五倍且性能更优。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a gradient-based bilevel co-design framework that replaces dynamics models with a differentiable neural surrogate (NeuralFoil), running about five times faster than state-of-the-art evolutionary baselines on fixed-wing glider tasks (maximum-distance gliding, minimum-distance landing, and perching) while outperforming pipelines that optimize aerodynamic proxy metrics.
